Welcome to the Jāgriti Hacks - by Jāgriti Technologies

An online hackathon where teams turn ideas into impactful solutions through coding, collaboration, and technical problem-solving.

About the Opportunity:

Jāgriti Hacks is an online hackathon by Siliguri Institute of Technology, designed for team participation in the Quizzes & Treasure Hunt category. Participants will move from understanding a chosen problem statement to presenting a working project through structured stages of ideation, coding, and evaluation.

Teams can showcase skills in cybersecurity frameworks, machine learning concepts, cloud computing, DevOps tools, and teamwork and collaboration. The online coding challenge offers a focused setting to develop solutions, explain technical choices, and demonstrate meaningful impact and feasibility.

Competition Structure:

The structure for this online coding challenge is as follows:

  • Application Screening: An initial profile-based screening stage where applicants are shortlisted according to their profile’s alignment with the opportunity.
  • Follow and join Jāgriti community and Instagram: Join the official WhatsApp community and follow Jāgriti on Instagram to receive announcements, deadlines, and mentor support throughout the hackathon. Completing this step is mandatory before participating in Round 1.
  • Round 1 PPT Submission: Submit a pitch deck covering your understanding of the problem, proposed solution approach, high-level architecture or technology stack, and expected impact and feasibility. No code is required at this stage.
  • Round 2 — Coding Sprint: Qualified teams build their solution during the provided coding window and submit a public GitHub repository link. The submission must include code committed within the window and a clear README explaining setup instructions, the technology stack, and how the solution addresses the chosen problem statement.
  • Live Demo & Technical Evaluation: Teams present a 10-minute live demo of their working project via Google Meet, followed by technical questions and answers with evaluators. The evaluation covers technical execution, architecture correctness, problem-specific constraints, and demo quality.

Rewards and Prizes:

Rewards & prize details (as provided):

  • Winner — $400: The top prize recognises the team that delivers the strongest overall performance in the hackathon. It also includes a pre-placement interview.
  • First Runner Up — $225: A cash prize and certificate recognising an outstanding team achievement.
  • Second Runner Up — $125: A cash prize and certificate celebrating another leading team performance.
  • Best Women Team in Tech — $100: A special prize and certificate recognising the best-performing women’s team in tech.

Bring your team, sharpen your ideas, and take on Jāgriti Hacks online with Siliguri Institute of Technology.
